w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Norman just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔️ Nadia stared down the Terms of Service and it backed off — 1 round, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 22 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/9/7), with 8 wave-4 fought, 13 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 7 · Craft 5 · Talk 13 · Explore 42 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivy Wang ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
